column1: County Health Rankings is a program of the University of Wisconsin Population Health Institute.
This Excel file contains the measure data, details, and Population Health and Well-being and Community Conditions summaries for each county in Texas for the 2025 Annual Data Release.
To learn more about our methods, please visit www.countyhealthrankings.org

1) Select Measure Data (including measure values, confidence intervals* and Z-scores**) - These measures contribute to the Population Health and Well-being and Community Conditions summaries. Measures appear in bold font.

3) Additional Measure Data (including measure values and confidence intervals*) - These supplemental measures do not contribute to the Population Health and Well-being and Community Conditions summaries and are included in the Health Snapshots to provide a broader picture of health and wellbeing.
5) Health Groups - Population Health and Well-being and Community Conditions summaries assigned to one of ten groups nationally using a data-informed grouping method.
*   95% confidence intervals are provided where applicable and available.

**  Z-scores are "adjusted" Z-scores (e.g., multiplied by -1 if a positively framed measure, set to the state average for missing and unreliable values, and truncated at -3 or +3 if county population is less than 20,000).
